### Payroll — FWC Awards UI refactor + import fixes — 2026-06-13

- **refactor: Awards page to full-page table + det-panel** — replaced the two-column card layout with a full-width `inv-list-table` list (matching Invoices/Bills pattern) and a `det-panel` slide-over for award detail. Row highlights on selection (`aw-row-active`). `← Payroll` nav button on toolbar. (`web/static/js/payroll.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: Classification ordering** — `get_fwc_classifications()` now sorts by `clause_fixed_id asc, classification_level asc`, following the FWC award document's canonical ordering to give correct sequential level listing within each clause/schedule. (`core/fwc.py`)
- **fix: Blank classifications imported** — parent/grouping nodes (classifications with no associated pay rates) are deleted after the pay rates step, leaving only payroll-usable leaf levels. (`core/awards.py`)
- **fix: Awards list not refreshing after FWC import** — `_renderAwardsPage()` was only called in the "award not found" branch after import; now always called before `_awSelect()` so the new row appears and is correctly highlighted. (`web/static/js/payroll.js`)
- **fix: FWC penalties — `URLError` silently swallowed** — `_get()` only caught `urllib.error.HTTPError`; timeout and connection resets raised `URLError` which propagated uncaught past `get_fwc_penalties`. Added `URLError` → `RuntimeError` conversion. (`core/fwc.py`)
- **fix: FWC penalties — single-page fetch** — `get_fwc_penalties()` previously fetched only one page (≤100 rows); switched to `_get_all_pages()` to retrieve all penalty records. (`core/fwc.py`)
- **fix: FWC import — empty penalties warning** — if the FWC penalties API returns no results, a warning is added to the import summary and shown as an error toast in the UI. (`core/awards.py`, `web/static/js/payroll.js`)
- **fix: `_get_all_pages` null results guard** — `data.get("results") or []` replaces `data.get("results", [])` to handle a nullable `results` field in FWC responses. (`core/fwc.py`)
- **fix: `detClose()` clears `_awCurrent`** — awards selection state is now reset when the det-panel is closed from another module context. (`web/static/js/invoices.js`)

### Payroll — FWC Modern Awards import — 2026-06-13

- **feat: Import from Fair Work Commission** — Awards page gains an "↓ Import from Fair Work" button that opens a search modal. Users enter a free subscription key from `developer.fwc.gov.au` once (stored in `payroll_settings` table). Searching queries the FWC REST API (`https://api.fwc.gov.au/api/v1/awards`) and lists matching Modern Awards. Clicking Import fetches classifications, all pay rates, wage allowances, expense allowances, and penalty rates from FWC and upserts them into local `award_classifications`, `award_pay_rates`, `award_allowances`, and `award_penalty_rates` tables. Re-importing the same award code updates existing records rather than duplicating. FWC rate types (weekly/hourly/annual/daily) are normalised to hourly + weekly. (`core/fwc.py` new, `core/awards.py`, `web/routes/payroll.py`, `web/static/js/payroll.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)

### POS — Low stock warning at sale — 2026-06-13

- **feat: Low stock warning at sale** — all three tender buttons (Cash, Card, Split) now route through `_posCheckStockWarnings(onProceed)` before opening the tender modal. Scans every inventoried cart line against `qty_on_hand` in the cached item catalogue; flags items that would go negative ("Oversell") or drop to/below reorder level ("Low stock"). If any warnings exist, shows a modal table listing item name, status badge, and post-sale qty. Operator can Cancel (abort the sale) or Proceed (continue to tender). Custom line items and non-inventoried items are silently skipped. No schema or backend changes — `qty_on_hand` and `reorder_level` are already in the POS items response. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)

### POS — Split tender input fix — 2026-06-13

- **fix: Split tender keyboard input** — `_posSplitUpdate` was overwriting the active input's `.value` on every keystroke, resetting the cursor mid-type and causing single-digit-only entry and step-increment behavior on digits 7/8/9. Fixed: only update the *other* field; never touch the field being typed in. Also: `step` tightened to `0.01`, `onclick="this.select()"` added for quick replacement. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)

### POS — Category filter bar + Split tender — 2026-06-13

- **feat: Category filter bar (gap 10)** — item grid now has a pill bar above it showing unique income account names. Clicking a pill filters the grid to that category; "All" shows everything. `_posRenderCatBar()` uses DOM element creation (not innerHTML) to eliminate any smart-quote risk on class attributes. Category is derived from `account_name` (already in the items response via JOIN). (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Split tender (gap 12)** — "Split" button added to the tender row. Flow: enter cash/card amounts (auto-adjusts to balance) → charge card on terminal → poll for approval → "Collect $X cash" confirmation → sale submitted. Two GL payment records created (cash → Cash Drawer account, card → EFTPOS Clearing account). `pos_sales` table gains `cash_amount` and `card_amount` columns (migration-safe ALTER TABLE). Z-report shows a "Split" row with per-leg totals; banking expected-cash calculation includes split cash portions. ESC/POS receipt prints "CASH: $X / CARD: $Y" for split sales. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **refactor: `_posShowReceipt()`** — rewritten with string concatenation only (no template literals) to permanently eliminate any smart-quote / SyntaxError risk. `_posCurrentReceipt` module-level variable stores receipt params for the "Print Receipt" button; `_posPrintReceiptCurrent()` reads from it. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)

### POS — Register PIN sign-on — 2026-06-12

- **feat: Per-user POS PIN** — Admin → Users page gains a "Set PIN / PIN set" button per user. Modal accepts a 4–6 digit numeric PIN, stores it hashed (`PBKDF2`) in `users.pos_pin_hash` (migration-safe ALTER TABLE). Clear button removes the PIN. `set_pos_pin()`, `clear_pos_pin()`, `get_pos_users()`, `authenticate_pos_pin()` added to `core/auth.py`; `POST/DELETE /api/users/<id>/pos-pin` routes added. `get_users()` now returns `has_pos_pin` flag. (`core/auth.py`, `web/routes/users.py`, `web/static/js/users.js`)
- **feat: PIN sign-on at register open** — clicking Open Register now checks if any users have PINs configured. If yes, shows a user-picker modal (avatar + name buttons) → tap name → 3×4 PIN pad with dot indicators. Correct PIN stores `_posPinUserId`/`_posPinUserName` and proceeds to the float/note screen. Wrong PIN shakes and clears. If no PINs are configured, skips directly to float entry (backward compatible). (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Operator name on session** — `opened_by_user_id` and `opened_by_name` stored on `pos_sessions` (migration-safe); passed through `open_pos_session()` and `api_pos_session_open`; shown in the session bar as `👤 Name` and in session history list. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`)
- **feat: PIN pad keyboard input** — while the PIN modal is open, digit keys enter the PIN, Backspace deletes one digit, Delete clears all, Escape goes back to user picker or closes the modal. Listener is attached on modal open and self-removes via MutationObserver on close. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: PIN pad layout** — standard 3×4 grid `[1-9, C, 0, ⌫]` with no empty cells; `aspect-ratio:1` square keys; C and ⌫ styled as muted function keys; 6 dot indicators for up to 6-digit PINs. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)

### POS — Refund receipt + store credit — 2026-06-12

- **feat: Refund receipt printing** — after a cash/card refund is confirmed, a "Refund Issued" modal shows CN number, total, and a Print Receipt button (auto-prints if `auto_print` is on). `print_refund_receipt()` sends a "REFUND RECEIPT" / "REFUNDED VIA CASH/CARD" ESC/POS receipt; `POST /api/pos/print-refund-receipt` route added. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Store credit option** — refund modal footer now has Cancel / Store Credit / Refund buttons. Store Credit issues a CN with no cash movement, leaving it unapplied for future invoices. Completion modal shows "Store Credit Issued" with a Print Credit Note button (prints "CREDIT NOTE" / "STORE CREDIT" header). `create_pos_store_credit()`, `print_credit_note_receipt()` added; `POST /api/pos/store-credit` and `POST /api/pos/print-credit-note` routes added. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Double-refund guard** — `get_pos_sales()` LEFT JOINs for any non-voided CN against each sale; returns `refunded=1` if found. History table Refund button is disabled and relabelled "Refunded" for already-refunded sales. (`core/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)

### POS — Refund / Return flow (gap 7) — 2026-06-12

- **feat: POS refund flow** — "Refund" button (btn-danger) on every sales history row. Clicking it closes the history modal, fetches the original invoice lines, and opens a refund modal where the operator can adjust per-line refund quantities and choose cash or card return tender. On confirm: `create_pos_refund()` issues a Credit Note (reverses income + GST Collected via `create_credit_note()`), posts a GL journal that debits AR and credits the cash drawer or EFTPOS clearing account, marks the CN settled, and shows a toast with the CN number and amount. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)

### POS — Gap Fill (audit 2026-06-12)

- **feat: Sales history UI** — "History" button in POS search bar opens a modal listing the last 100 POS sales (invoice number, date, customer, tender type, total) with a "Print" button to reprint each receipt to the thermal printer. Backend updated: `get_pos_sales` now JOINs `pos_sales` + `contacts` to return tender and customer name. (`core/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Cash drawer open button** — "⎏ Drawer" button in POS search bar sends the ESC/POS cash drawer kick command (pin 2: `ESC p 0 \x19 \xfa`) via the configured network printer. `open_cash_drawer()` added to `core/pos.py`; `POST /api/pos/open-drawer` route added. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Float-to-keep editable** — the "Float to Keep" input in the banking step is no longer read-only; editing it automatically updates "Amount to Bank" (and vice versa). `_posFloatChange()` added. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Session history** — "Sessions" button in cart header opens a modal listing all sessions (open/closed, tx count, total, note). Clicking "Z-Report"/"X-View" on any row opens that session's report in the standard Z-report modal (print-only, no Close Register button). `get_pos_sessions()` added to `core/pos.py`; `GET /api/pos/sessions` route added. `_posRenderZReport` gains a `readOnly` param. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Session note on open dialog** — "Open Register" modal now includes an optional "Session note" text field (e.g. "Morning shift, Jane"); stored in `pos_sessions.note` and shown in Session History. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Fractional quantities** — qty input now uses `parseFloat` + `step="0.001"` instead of `parseInt`; allows quantities like 1.5 kg, 0.75 m. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Sales history filters** — History modal now loads up to 200 sales and provides a sticky filter bar: from/to date, customer text search, tender (Cash/Card/All), min and max amount. Count + running total update live as filters change. Clear button resets all filters. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Invoice PDF on history rows** — each row in the sales history modal now has a Receipt button (thermal reprint) and an Invoice button (opens full invoice PDF in a new tab). (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Invoice PDF on receipt modal** — the "✓ Sale Complete" modal now has three buttons: Print Receipt, Invoice PDF, New Sale. Modal widened from 320px to 400px to accommodate. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)

### POS — Banking Report + Float Fix — 2026-06-11

- **feat: Banking report in closed Z-report** — closed Z-report now includes a formal BANKING REPORT section: Cash subsection (opening float → cash sales → expected in drawer → counted/variance if counted → cash deposited / float retained), Card/EFTPOS subsection (transaction count + total, settled-direct note), and TOTAL BANKING line (cash deposited + card total). Shows on every closed session regardless of whether till was counted. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: Opening float not defaulting after in-session close** — after closing a session within the same page load, `_posLastFloat` was not updated; "Open Register" float input fell back to the page-load value. Fixed by assigning `_posLastFloat = floatKept` immediately after `_posSession = null` in `_posDoCloseSession`. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)

### POS — Square, Till Balance, Banking, Customer Picker — 2026-06-11

- **fix: Square sandbox URL** — Square sandbox uses `connect.squareupsandbox.com`, not `connect.squareup.com`; added `_square_base(settings)` helper that switches URL based on `square_sandbox` flag. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: Square sandbox mode toggle** — "Sandbox Mode" checkbox added to POS Settings (visible when Square is selected); stored as `square_sandbox` column in `pos_settings`; passed to `_charge_square` and `_get_square_status`. (`core/pos_settings.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: Square error detail** — `_charge_square` now reads the HTTP response body on error and includes it in the `RuntimeError` message so 400/401 responses show Square's full error JSON. (`core/pos.py`)
- **fix: Z-report GST accuracy** — GST now read from `invoice_lines.gst_amount` (GL truth) via a subquery join, replacing the previously stored per-item rounded cart totals which accumulated rounding error. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: Till balance step** — "Close Register" now goes through a 3-step modal: Z-report preview → Balance Till (shows opening float + cash sales vs actual counted, live variance) → Banking (amount to bank, float to keep). (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Opening float on session open** — "Open Register" modal now prompts for opening float (defaults $0.00); stored in `pos_sessions.opening_float`. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Banking journal** — on session close, if `banked > 0` and a banking account is configured, posts a journal entry (Dr banking account, Cr cash drawer account). (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: Banking account in POS settings** — "Banking Account" selector added alongside Cash/Card accounts; stored as `banking_account_id` in `pos_settings`. (`core/pos_settings.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Till balance summary on Z-report** — closed Z-report shows opening float, cash sales, expected vs counted, variance (green/red), amount banked, and float kept. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Customer picker on cart** — "+ Add Customer" button below session bar; opens a searchable contact modal; selected customer shown with clear (✕) button; assigned contact used as invoice contact instead of walk-in default; resets after each sale. (`core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)

### POS — Linkly EFTPOS Adapter — 2026-06-11

- **feat: Linkly Cloud REST adapter** — `_charge_linkly` / `_get_linkly_status` / `_linkly_get_token` in `core/pos.py`; uses synchronous mode (`async=false`) so the POST blocks until the customer taps (~5–30 s), then stores the result in `_linkly_checkouts` so the JS poll loop resolves immediately. Bearer token cached in-memory for 23 hrs. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: Linkly terminal pairing** — `pair_linkly_terminal(db_path, username, password, pair_code)` calls the Linkly pairing endpoint, stores the returned `secret` as `api_key` in pos_settings, and auto-generates a `posId` if one doesn't exist. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: Pair Terminal UI** — "Pair Terminal" button row in POS Settings (visible only when Linkly is selected); opens a modal prompting for Linkly username, password, and the pair code shown on the PIN pad; on success updates the paired status inline without reopening settings. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Linkly provider option** — "Linkly (CBA / NAB / Westpac / ANZ bank terminals)" added to provider dropdown; API key and Device ID fields hidden (managed by pairing); pair row shown instead. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: `POST /api/pos/terminal/pair` route** — validates inputs and calls `pair_linkly_terminal`. (`web/routes/pos.py`)
- **feat: Linkly wired into dispatchers** — `charge_terminal()` and `get_terminal_status()` both handle `provider == "linkly"`. (`core/pos.py`)
- **note: Sandbox URLs hardcoded** — `_LINKLY_AUTH/TXN/PAIR` point to `sandbox.cloud.pceftpos.com`; swap to production constants when ISV accreditation is complete.

### POS — Thermal Receipt Printer — 2026-06-10

- **feat: Network thermal printer support** — ESC/POS receipt sent over raw TCP socket (no new dependencies); supports any 80mm network printer at a configurable IP/port (default 9100). (`core/pos.py`, `core/pos_settings.py`)
- **feat: Full receipt format** — company name (double-height), ABN, address, phone; TAX INVOICE heading; date/time + receipt number; line items with qty × price; subtotal / GST / TOTAL; tender type and change. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: Printer settings** — enable toggle, IP address, port, and auto-print-after-sale checkbox added to POS Settings modal. Settings persisted in `pos_settings` table with migration for existing files. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `core/pos_settings.py`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Print Receipt button** — receipt modal now calls `POST /api/pos/print-receipt` instead of `window.print()`; button shows "Printing…" state and toasts success/failure. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/routes/pos.py`)
- **feat: Auto-print** — if auto-print is enabled in settings, receipt is sent to the printer automatically after each sale without requiring a button press. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)

### App — Pay via Terminal on Invoices — 2026-06-09

- **feat: Pay via Terminal button** — appears alongside "Record Payment" on any Sent or Partial invoice with an outstanding balance; initiates a card charge on the configured POS terminal (Tyro, Square, or Mock) without leaving the invoices module. (`web/static/js/invoices.js`)
